currentWork.title: FINAL.25 route guidance display — production released and verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.25 is live on GitHub Pages. PR #147 merged to main at c8c5908a576c449b2832f226c622534a0a08ddc1. Vercel production deployment dpl_3xTUZDNv9yNAXfebar6tFWw1Zh3G is READY. Live version.json reports 2026.10.06-FINAL.25.
scope: Truck routes render ordinary-road sections in blue and ORS waycategory Highway (motorway/motorway_link) sections in orange.

Current position uses a direction arrow when heading is known: reported Geolocation heading first, otherwise bearing from meaningful movement; last reliable heading is retained when movement is too small to infer a new direction.

Displayed GPS motion is interpolated smoothly between fixes. Clearly poor fixes above 100m accuracy do not move the visual marker, while raw runtime GPS state is still preserved for existing route-position handling.
User-entered vehicle dimensions and gross weight remain per-user data; validation values are not hard-coded.
Analytics engine, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain unchanged.
